commitments.detail: Vendor shall delete all customer support chat and call transcript data within 30 days of the end of the contract term.
Vendor is permitted to use the data for model training purposes.
All processing of the data shall occur within the US region.
Vendor must maintain cyber insurance coverage of at least $500,000.
Company is to be named as an additional insured party under the Vendor's insurance policy.
Vendor shall allow for an annual audit of their data handling practices by an independent third party.
Vendor agrees to unlimited indemnity for any confidentiality or data breaches involving the customer support chat and call transcript data.
